"This is a line chart depicting the "Stock of Domestic Arrears" in Argentina, measured in Billions of AR$ (daily average).

### **Chart Overview**
*   **Title:** Stock of Domestic Arrears
*   **Units:** Billions of AR$, daily average
*   **Y-Axis:** Value from 0 to 6,000 in increments of 1,000.
*   **X-Axis:** Timeline from January 2023 to July 2024.
*   **Legend:**
    *   **Light Blue Line:** Actual data.
    *   **Dark Blue Line:** Arrears target (7th review).

### **Data Values (Estimated from Y-Axis Scale)**

| Time Period | Actual (Light Blue) | Arrears Target (Dark Blue) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Jan-23 to Mar-23** | ~700 | ~1,200 |
| **Mar-23 to May-23** | Rising from ~700 to ~1,000 | ~1,200 |
| **May-23 to Jul-23** | ~1,000 | ~1,200 |
| **Jul-23 to Sep-23** | ~1,250 | ~1,350 |
| **Sep-23 to Dec-23** | Rising from ~1,250 to ~1,650 | ~1,350 |
| **Jan-24 to Mar-24** | ~1,550 (horizontal segment) | No Target shown for this specific window |
| **Feb-24 to Jul-24** | No Data | ~5,300 (horizontal segment) |

### **Key Observations**
*   **Actual Performance:** The "Actual" stock of domestic arrears showed a steady upward trend through 2023, starting at approximately 700 billion AR$ in early 2023 and reaching approximately 1,650 billion AR$ by the end of the year.
*   **Comparison to Target:** Throughout most of 2023, the actual arrears remained below the set target. However, in late 2023 (around September/October), the actual amount surpassed the target of approximately 1,350 billion AR$.
*   **Target Adjustment:** There is a significant jump in the "Arrears target" for the 2024 period, shifting from approximately 1,350 billion AR$ in late 2023 to approximately 5,300 billion AR$ for the first half of 2024."
